range: From {{from}} to {{to}}. Days in the plan: {{days}}.

summary.howItWorks: Every calendar day has four 60-minute self-study sessions: economics, maths, geography and English. Up to four optional 15-minute transfer tasks extend the day to five hours. Tutors and breaks are excluded. Workload, completed work, daily quota and remaining clock ceiling are separate. Past hours and exam sittings are excluded; conflicts never create fictional completion or catch-up debt. Earlier progress is retained. Preparation stops at the final paper’s start; the plan closes at its confirmed end for the selected room.

debt.title: Catching up: {{time}} from earlier days
debt.text: This work moves to the next days that have time for the subject.

unplaced.title: Not everything fits before the exams
unplaced.text: Catch up on a weekend, or raise the daily study time in Settings.

finished.title: Preparation period ended
finished.text: The final exam has ended. No new preparation debt is created; the library and history remain available.

day.restText: With a zero budget, all four activities remain visible with a time conflict.
day.empty: Nothing is planned for this day.
